{
  "notes_md": "## Key ideas
- The new BuddiPole PowerPro combines the best features of previous PowerMini and PowerPlus devices.
- It features an MPPT solar charge controller with a boost function to handle low voltage from solar panels while continuing to charge batteries.
- The unit includes a high-contrast color OLED display, CNC machine control knob, and user-definable alarms and low-voltage cutoffs.
- It supports automatic failover and seamless switching between power sources without interrupting connected gear.
- It is slated for production release around mid-July with a targeted retail price between $329 and $349.

## Quotes
- "This falls in line with our PowerMini, which has been out for a few years now, solar controller, and our PowerPlus device." [00:07]
- "We now have a newer version which kind of takes the best of both worlds here... the solar charge controller is MPPT and we have a boost function here." [00:27]
- "This will also do auto-failover, so if you lose commercial power, it'll automatically swap over to the battery." [02:50]

## Why it matters for me
Data science applications often rely on robust, uninterrupted power systems for field data collection and remote monitoring nodes. Advanced MPPT tracking, battery voltage monitoring, and automatic power failover ensure reliable edge computing infrastructure in remote or off-grid environments.

## Try next
- Review the exact voltage and current thresholds for battery chemistry settings on the PowerPro display.
- Investigate how MPPT boost controllers optimize power efficiency for variable solar setups.",
